title: merchantframe
summary: Merchant money, row projection, paging, shell, live vendor portrait, current-Benilla zero-discount repair arithmetic, release-owned repair interaction, exact GameText/WowSkin item-hover rendering, repair tooltip/button states, protocol bodies, and shared tooltip money pass bounded deterministic checks. Remaining work is concentrated in current-Benilla's own deferred drag-buy/shared cursor-item authority, panel authority, authenticated buyback verification, and human acceptance.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI implements the shared denomination, collapse, order, width, and atlas-UV money law used by merchant and tooltip presentations.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI implements stable row identity and the frozen first-ten merchant grid with protected hit bounds; buyback-only row reachability remains outside this claim.
Request/list/buy basics exist, but frozen left-click PickupMerchantItem and shared cursor-item authority remain incomplete.

The complete template-source item projection and exact row-owned GameText/WowSkin presentation are implemented. Shared carried-item cursor arbitration and authenticated live verification remain incomplete.

The merchant item tooltip projection and renderer pass the focused clinical check: bottom-left is seated on the row's top-right, the authored tooltip backdrop/thicken and GameText fonts/colors draw through the shared immutable renderer, and raw ImGui tooltip/table layout is source-fenced out. Needs owner-run live hover acceptance across weapons, armor, bags, requirements, sold-out items and buyback rows.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI projects merchant item state into the authored row chrome, name/count stack, highlight, and tint legs.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. The server-backed merchant list, ten-row paging, controls, and bottom-border presentation are implemented.
Buyback commands and partial presentation support exist, but the complete twelve-slot server snapshot and page projection are not implemented.
Recent buyback remains dependent on the missing authenticated complete buyback snapshot.
Repair input, disabled-state fencing, and hover title behavior are implemented, but the frozen reputation-discount cost contract remains missing.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The refreshed Benilla source explicitly says 'No reputation model yet -> discount 0' and calls repair_cost(..., 0.0). MSUI resolves the same DurabilityCosts/DurabilityQuality cells, applies the same two-stage rounding with a zero runtime discount, and keeps the reputation parameter in the frozen law for later data support.

openItems.text: Merchant show/update/close and money refresh exist, but shared UIPanel left-slot authority and replacement semantics remain incomplete.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the 384 by 512 merchant shell and exact four-quadrant authored texture composition.
The authored portrait seat exists, but live vendor-GUID portrait resolution is not implemented.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: DrawVendorPortrait resolves _vendor.VendorGuid through the live entity store and passes that exact unit to the shared DrawUnitPortraitImage model-bake path at the authored 60x60 TOPLEFT (7,-6) seat; the buyback tab swaps to UI-BuyBack-Icon as the reference does.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. Merchant row prices use the frozen left-to-right coin-chain geometry, NumberFontNormal digits, UVs, and collapse law.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. The merchant purse uses the frozen right-aligned coin-chain geometry, NumberFontNormal digits, UVs, and collapse law.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI implements a shared-law tooltip money row with exact denomination collapse, coin UVs, NumberFontNormal digits, and clear/set replacement semantics.
